hierarchy_spec.description: Authoritative Multi-Agency Landslide Risk Data Hierarchy & Decoupled Pipeline

tiers.name: GSI NLFC Ground Truth & Geotechnical Susceptibility
tiers.lead_agency: Geological Survey of India (GSI) - National Landslide Forecasting Centre (NLFC)
tiers.operational_role: Primary ground-truth labels and static susceptibility baseline
tiers.primary_dataset: National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (NLSM) 1:50,000 & Field Inventory
tiers.coverage: Pan-India Hilly Tracts (Western Ghats, Eastern Ghats, Himalayas, North-East)
key_features: GSI 8 Core Susceptibility Factors (Slope, Aspect, Shape, Lithology, Structure, Geomorphology, LULC, Geohydrology)
Field-validated crown-crack dilatancy and shear slip records
Geotechnical laboratory shear strength parameters (cohesion c', internal friction phi', unit soil weight gamma)
tiers.citation: Geological Survey of India, National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (NLSM) Programme, Kolkata, India.
tiers.license_type: Government of India Open Data / GSI NLFC Official Scientific Portal
tiers.special_capability: Ground-truth calibration benchmark preventing model hallucination

tiers.name: ISRO NRSC Landslide Atlas of India (~80,000 Historical Events)
tiers.lead_agency: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) / Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
tiers.operational_role: Historical spatial-temporal training corpus and regional risk exposure catalog
tiers.update_cadence: Multi-decadal historical catalog (1998-2022) with annual post-event satellite supplements
tiers.primary_dataset: Landslide Atlas of India (1998-2022) Database (80,000+ Mapped Landslides)
tiers.coverage: 17 Indian States and 2 Union Territories across Western Ghats and Himalayas
key_features: Seasonal, event-based, and route-wise landslide inventories
Spatially mapped historical polygons and scar coordinates
Socio-economic exposure indices, damage intensity classifications, and runout zones
tiers.citation: NRSC/ISRO (2023). Landslide Atlas of India: Spatial database of landslides in India (1998-2022). National Remote Sensing Centre, Hyderabad.
tiers.license_type: ISRO Bhuvan Geo-Platform Public Scientific License
tiers.special_capability: Enables high-sample-volume offline training across 80,000+ ground-validated historical disaster events

tiers.name: IMD Meteorological Triggers & Climatology
tiers.lead_agency: India Meteorological Department (IMD) & Open Government Data (data.gov.in)
tiers.operational_role: Dynamic triggering variables, antecedent rainfall indices, and live precipitation telemetry
tiers.update_cadence: 15-Minute AWS Telemetry, 3-Hourly Synoptic, and Daily Rainfall Grids
tiers.primary_dataset: IMD 0.25° x 0.25° Daily Gridded Rainfall & Real-Time Automatic Weather Station (AWS) Streams
tiers.coverage: National Coverage with High-Density AWS Mesonets in Western Ghats / Nilgiris
key_features: Localized convective cloudburst tracking and monsoon climatology baselines
tiers.citation: India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences, New Delhi & data.gov.in.
tiers.license_type: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) / Open Government Data License India
tiers.special_capability: Powers hydrodynamic pore-pressure elevation calculations in real-time

tiers.name: Copernicus Data Space Sentinel-1 SAR & Sentinel-2 MSI
tiers.lead_agency: European Space Agency (ESA) / Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
tiers.operational_role: All-weather cloud-penetrating radar deformation & multispectral vegetation scar analysis
tiers.update_cadence: Sentinel-1 SAR 6-to-12 day repeat pass; Sentinel-2 MSI 5-day repeat pass
tiers.primary_dataset: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR GRD/SLC & Sentinel-2 Level-2A BOA Surface Reflectance
tiers.coverage: Global / Sub-Continental Repeat Passes over Peninsular India
key_features: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR backscatter (VV/VH) & interferometric coherence (InSAR) surface displacement
All-weather day/night cloud penetration during heavy monsoon storms when optical cameras are blinded
Sentinel-2 MSI Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) drop and barren scar demarcation
tiers.citation: European Space Agency (ESA) Copernicus Sentinel Data (2024), Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.
tiers.license_type: Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0 / Copernicus Open Access Policy
tiers.special_capability: Cloudburst Penetration: C-band microwave radar penetrates 100% cloud cover to detect slope movement while torrential rains rage

tiers.name: OpenStreetMap (OSM) Infrastructure & NHAI / PWD Corridors
tiers.lead_agency: OpenStreetMap Contributors & State Public Works Departments (PWD / NHAI)
tiers.operational_role: Lifeline network vulnerability, road corridor disruptions, and evacuation routing constraints
tiers.update_cadence: Continuous community and municipal cadastral updates
tiers.primary_dataset: OpenStreetMap Planet Extract (Roads, Bridges, Culverts, Buildings, Settlements)
tiers.coverage: High-detail geographic feature topology across Wayanad, Idukki, Nilgiris, and Ghat passes
key_features: Primary arterial highways (NH-766, SH-59) and mountain pass hairpin roads
Bridges, culverts, river crossings, and vulnerable toe-scour abutments
Hospital, shelter, and school evacuation staging zones
tiers.special_capability: Enables real-time arterial evacuation pathing and critical lifeline disruption warning under ODbL 1.0

gsi_8_factors.name: Slope Gradient
gsi_8_factors.description: Topographic inclination derived from 12.5m/30m high-resolution Digital Elevation Models (DEM). Slopes > 35° represent acute shear stress zones.

gsi_8_factors.name: Slope Aspect
gsi_8_factors.description: Compass facing direction of the hillside. Controls solar insolation, evapotranspiration rates, and prevailing monsoon windward precipitation interception (e.g., SW monsoon in Western Ghats).
gsi_8_factors.typical_range: 0° - 360° (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW)

gsi_8_factors.name: Slope Shape / Curvature
gsi_8_factors.description: Profile and planform curvature characterizing convergent vs. divergent hydrology. Concave hollows concentrate subsurface pore-water pressure and initiate debris flows.
gsi_8_factors.typical_range: Concave (-1.0 to -0.1), Planar (-0.1 to 0.1), Convex (0.1 to 1.0)

gsi_8_factors.name: Lithology & Weathering Grade
gsi_8_factors.agency_standard: Geological Survey of India 1:50k Lithological Maps
gsi_8_factors.description: Subsurface bedrock lithology (e.g., Charnockite, Khondalite, Hornblende-biotite gneiss) and residual saprolite/colluvium depth. Highly weathered rocks exhibit severe cohesion decay when saturated.
gsi_8_factors.typical_range: Sound Bedrock (Grade I) to Completely Decomposed Saprolite (Grade V/VI)

gsi_8_factors.name: Structural Discontinuities & Lineaments
gsi_8_factors.unit: km to fault / km/km² lineament density
gsi_8_factors.description: Proximity to tectonic faults, thrusts, shear zones, and high-density fracture lineaments. Daylighted dipping joints dipping parallel to slope create catastrophic planar slip surfaces.
gsi_8_factors.typical_range: 0.0 - 15.0 km fault buffer; 0.0 - 4.5 km/km² lineament density

gsi_8_factors.name: Geomorphology & Landform Unit
gsi_8_factors.description: Quaternary landforms including escarpment faces, paleo-landslide scars, debris fans, talus cones, and entrenched river valleys prone to lateral toe-scour.
gsi_8_factors.typical_range: Ridge Crest, Upper Slope, Escarpment, Colluvial Fan, Valley Floor

gsi_8_factors.name: Land Use & Land Cover (LULC)
gsi_8_factors.description: Vegetation root-binding cohesion vs. anthropogenic destabilization. Deep-rooted evergreen canopy reinforces slope stability, whereas monoculture plantations (tea/rubber) or slope-toe road excavations elevate failure risk.
gsi_8_factors.typical_range: Dense Forest (high root cohesion) to Open Quarry / Road Cut (extreme vulnerability)

gsi_8_factors.name: Geohydrology & Topographic Wetness
gsi_8_factors.description: Steady-state wetness index quantifying topographic control on hydrological processes and saturation overland flow zones, integrated with perennial drainage line density.

hierarchy_spec.offline_decoupling_mandate: Machine learning models are strictly trained offline using versioned datasets (Tier 1 GSI + Tier 2 ISRO NRSC Atlas + Tier 3 IMD Climatology + Tier 4 Sentinel SAR). The operational dashboard consumes frozen, validated model checkpoints and does NOT retrain or contaminate model weights with live transient telemetry.

decoupled_architecture.mandate: Model parameters are permanently decoupled from runtime dashboard telemetry.
